body:
Guides the company through the Spiral and opens a route while the adventurers defend the ritual.

Recorded role and choices

Seravelle describes the present vessel as a guide. In the checked December 2024 quest, the guide leads the company onward, works the doorway’s nodes and warns that the ritual must be protected. After completing the mechanism, Seravelle distracts the approaching creatures so the company can proceed. The nature behind the vessel and its later fate remain unresolved; the guide’s promises are kept as attributed explanations.

Prominence and evidence

Prominence unrated. The source footprint alone does not establish the importance of this identity. Consequences, institutional or witness role and relationships need a supported assessment.

Recorded presence combines dialogue volume and span. A brief appearance can still have lasting consequences; missing context is left unrated rather than assigned a low importance.
